method: Original 0x1989e60 runs natively in Unicorn over the memory image, including its inlined pointer-vector growth. Only the three allocator vtable entries (+8/+0x10/+0x18) are supplied stubs. The Python reconstruction runs on the same fixtures with an authored mirror allocator.
comparisons: ordered allocator calls with every argument (size, alignment, tag, old pointer)
all fixture bytes: context pointer array, the three vector headers of every context, initial element arrays and newly allocated arrays
coverage: skewed, random, balanced, near-limit and full-capacity count shapes
null and nonnull storage, capacity equal to or above count, growth from zero (8) and doubling
all three vectors at +0, +0x10 and +0x20 with independent limits
limits: Contexts are distinct pointers; aliased context pointers are not exercised (they would not terminate natively).
Allocator is a supplied stand-in; the mirror is authored and not engine behavior.
Counts above capacity and 32-bit sum wrap are not exercised.
Zero-context fault is compared only as occurrence plus memory state.
